subject: Emotions
title: Love Blindness
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Love Blindness.

hook.text: Friends see the red flags. You don't. Romantic love literally deactivates your brain's critical judgment circuits.

buildup.text: Semir Zeki's brain scans showed that love suppresses the prefrontal cortex and amygdala—areas for judgment and fear.

discovery.text: Neural suppression evolved to reduce hesitation. If early humans over-analyzed mates, they'd miss mating opportunities.

twist.text: The same regions shut down in romantic and maternal love. You're blind to your baby's faults for the same reason.

climax.text: Love blindness fades as dopamine normalizes—usually around 18 months. This is when couples first notice major flaws.

punchline.text: Love doesn't make you blind. It switches off the lights.

quiz.question: What brain areas does romantic love suppress?
